concepts.gloss_en: Peace within oneself (inner peace of body and soul) — one of the two kinds of peace

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are from LM 1:14 §8-9 and refer to the identical concept — 'peace within oneself' (body/soul harmony), explicitly named as one of the two types of peace. The 'כשיש' variant is just the same phrase with the prefix 'when there is', not a distinct word or concept. Same vocalization (בַּעֲצָמָיו) throughout; no homograph issue.
